chương trình thạc sĩ marketing tại văn l: The Master of Marketing program at Van Lang helps students develop in-depth knowledge, research thinking and marketing strategy planning capacity in a global business environment and digital transformation.
nội dung học tập kết nối marketing bền v: Learning content connects sustainable marketing, data analysis, digital strategy and customer experience management. Students practice the ability to identify problems, evaluate evidence and develop marketing solutions linked to business practice.
chương trình được thiết kế theo định hướ: The program follows a research track, emphasizing research methods, marketing research modules and a thesis. This foundation supports careers in management, consulting, research and teaching, as well as further study.
Deepen Your Knowledge. Ground Your Research in Evidence.
định hướng nghiên cứu 24 tháng · 4 học k: The research track 24 months · 4 semesters 60 credits
chiến lược marketing trong môi trường số: Marketing strategy in the digital environment
kết nối tư duy marketing bền vững với ch: Connect sustainable marketing thinking with integrated digital and multi-channel strategy, helping students analyze the market, understand the customer journey and build solutions suitable to the business context.
học phần phân tích kinh doanh và dự báo: The Business Analytics and Forecasting module develops quantitative thinking and the ability to use data to evaluate demand, sales and customer behavior, supporting informed marketing decisions.
chuyên đề nghiên cứu marketing kết hợp s: Marketing research module combines seminars, academic reviews and practical research sessions at businesses. Students gradually develop problems, design research and prepare for a 15-credit thesis.
quyền riêng tư, quản trị dữ liệu, liêm c: Privacy, data governance, academic integrity and social responsibility are placed together with professional competencies, driving responsible Marketing decisions and sustainable value for organizations, customers and communities.
sáu chuẩn đầu ra bao quát kiến thức chuy: Six learning outcomes cover in-depth knowledge, research and management skills, along with autonomy and professional responsibility.
phân tích và tích hợp kiến thức nâng cao: Analyze and integrate advanced, in-depth knowledge of Marketing, management and interdisciplinary knowledge to evaluate complex Marketing issues in a global context.
phân tích và tích hợp công nghệ, dữ liệu: Analyze and integrate technology, data and emerging trends to develop innovative Marketing solutions.
thực hiện nghiên cứu marketing ở trình đ: Conduct Marketing research at an advanced level to develop knowledge and solve in-depth problems in the field of Marketing.
giao tiếp học thuật và nghề nghiệp hiệu: Communicate effectively in academic and professional settings, and manage and lead professional activities in complex marketing contexts.
thể hiện mức độ tự chủ cao, liêm chính h: Demonstrate a high level of autonomy, academic integrity, professional ethics and social responsibility in Marketing research and practice.
thể hiện năng lực đổi mới sáng tạo, tự đ: Demonstrate the capacity for innovation, self-direction and lifelong learning to develop expertise and adapt to changes in science, technology and the business environment.

chương trình đào tạo theo định hướng nào: Which Track Does the Program Offer?
chương trình thạc sĩ marketing được thiế: The Master of Marketing follows a research track, comprising 60 credits over a standard duration of 24 months and 4 semesters. Coursework is scheduled in the first three semesters, with Semester 4 devoted to the 15-credit thesis.
tôi cần đáp ứng điều kiện gì để dự tuyển: What conditions do I need to meet to apply?
ứng viên đã tốt nghiệp hoặc đủ điều kiện: Applicants must hold or be eligible to receive, a bachelor's degree or higher in an appropriate field and complete any required bridging courses. The research track requires a bachelor's degree classified as Good or above or relevant research publications. Applicants must also meet the foreign language and other entry requirements.
tốt nghiệp ngành khác có thể dự tuyển ma: Can I apply for Marketing if I graduate from another major?
ứng viên tốt nghiệp ngành khác được đối: Applicants from other fields may submit their qualifications, transcripts and previous coursework for review. Up to 12 bridging credits may be required across four 3-credit courses including Introduction to Economics, Principles of Management, Fundamentals of Marketing and Principles of Finance. Exemptions for equivalent courses are considered based on the application; all required courses must be completed before admission assessment.
ngôn ngữ giảng dạy và yêu cầu ngoại ngữ: What is the language of instruction and foreign language requirements?
The program is taught in Vietnamese. Applicants must demonstrate foreign language proficiency equivalent to Level 3 or above; students must reach Level 4 or above under Vietnam's six-level foreign language proficiency framework before graduation. Accepted evidence is assessed according to University regulations and announcements.
lịch học có phù hợp với người đang đi là: Is the study schedule suitable for working people?
lịch học dự kiến bố trí vào buổi tối các: Class schedule is expected to be arranged in the evenings on weekdays and/or Saturdays and Sundays. The official timetable is published each semester. You can discuss with the Institute to proactively arrange your work and study plan.
học phí và chính sách hỗ trợ được áp dụn: How are tuition fees and support policies applied?
học phí toàn khóa là 90.000.000 đồng, ch: Total program tuition is VND 90,000,000, divided into three installments: VND 31,500,000, VND 27,000,000 and VND 31,500,000. Additional fees apply on a case-by-case basis. Scholarships and financial support are assessed according to University eligibility criteria, supporting documents and announcements; only the highest eligible benefit within the specified policy groups applies, with no combining of benefits.
